services_not_configured: Configure the services in the services section of jgates.yml (compose files, services to start, target).
services_unknown: The compose files have no service named {service}.
services_refused: Governed mode refuses these host effects of the services: {effects}. The policy must allow them (services.allowHostEffects).
services_compose_unreadable: A compose file could not be read: {detail}
services_effect_project_bind: The service {service} mounts a folder of the project ({detail}); JGates mounts it read-only.
services_effect_writable: The service {service} may write to the project folder ({detail}), because services.writableBinds allows it.
services_build: Will build {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} of your compose ({services}): this runs the project's Dockerfile.
services_refused_effect: Governed mode refuses the host effect of the service {service} ({kind}: {detail}) because the policy does not allow it (services.allowHostEffects).
services_refused_writable: Governed mode never lets the service {service} write to the project folder ({detail}); remove it from services.writableBinds.
